t: What he answered when a woman had nothing to wear
a: لِتُلْبِسْهَا صَاحِبَتُهَا مِنْ جِلْبَابِهَا، وَلْتَشْهَدِ الْخَيْرَ وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
p: Li-tulbis-hā ṣāḥibatuhā min jilbābihā, wa li-tashhadi-l-khayra wa daʿwata-l-muslimīn
m: Let her companion lend her part of her own outer garment, and let her be present for the good and the supplication of the Muslims.
